title: ULA bugs.yaml — potential issues found during one unit's pass

unit.description: Unit slug (the unit this block covers).

bugs.description: Potential issues whose defect is IN this unit, AFTER Step D verification — kept because they are real (harmless-but-real ones carry severity 'negligible'). May be empty.

id.description: Slug from the bug's essence, unique within this unit.

title.description: Short: what the bug is and how it impacts us.

impact-summary.description: Plain-language summary of the bug's essence and impact, understandable by ANY engineer regardless of the technical stack — use general engineering terms, not stack-specific jargon. (The deep technical detail goes in 'description'.)

description.description: Deep technical detail: how to trigger/reproduce, the precondition it rests on, components involved. Step D may append its verification reasoning here.

nature.description: product: affects the product / user experience — wrong, inconsistent, or unexpected behaviour a user can encounter. technical: affects system internals — memory growth, leaks, inefficiency, excessive CPU, technical crashes, etc. Classify by the bug's dominant nature.

severity.description: Real impact after Step D (not how sure it is). critical: data loss/corruption, security, or crash/wrong-result on a normal path. high: serious but bounded (edge-triggered/recoverable/workaround). medium: limited blast radius. low: minor/robustness/hardening. negligible: real but harmless — no real effect as the system actually runs.

confidence.description: How sure this IS a bug. high: solid reasoning. medium: rests on unverified assumptions (callers/inputs/environment). low: speculative lead.

category.description: Optional. Bug TYPE — not importance (that is 'severity'), not product-vs-technical (that is 'nature').

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for nuance the category cannot capture.

crossUnit.description: Potential bugs found WHILE analyzing this unit but whose defect does NOT belong to it — located in another unit/file (kind=external), or emergent from several units' interaction (kind=interaction). Recorded here, attributed to this pass, rather than dropped. A later aggregation step dedups, routes, and promotes them; do not attempt that here. May be empty.

id.description: Slug from the finding's essence, unique within this unit (across bugs, crossUnit, and dismissed).

title.description: Short: what the bug is and how it impacts us.

impact-summary.description: Plain-language summary of the bug's essence and impact, understandable by ANY engineer regardless of the technical stack — general engineering terms, not stack-specific jargon. (Deep technical detail goes in 'description'.)

description.description: Deep technical detail: how to trigger/reproduce and which components are involved. For kind=interaction, spell out which units/files combine, the interaction, and why the combination fails.

nature.description: product: affects the product / user experience. technical: affects system internals (memory, leaks, inefficiency, CPU, crashes). Classify by the dominant nature.

targets.description: The unit(s)/file(s)/symbol(s) this finding concerns — free-form names; aggregation normalizes later. One for external; two or more for interaction.

kind.description: external: the defect lives in one other unit. interaction: emergent — each unit may be correct alone, the combination is the bug.

severity.description: Impact IF real. Same scale as bugs[].severity.

confidence.description: How sure this IS a bug. Same scale as bugs[].confidence.

dismissed.description: Findings judged NOT to be real bugs (false positives), at either stage — the per-unit Step D or the aggregation-level re-verification (see 'dismissed-by'). Preserved here — NOT deleted — with their ORIGINAL Step A fields intact, so the history of what the finder proposed stays available for false-positive analysis (and in case a dismissal was itself wrong). May be empty.

id.description: The bug's ORIGINAL Step A slug, preserved verbatim.

title.description: ORIGINAL Step A title, preserved verbatim — do not rewrite it.

impact-summary.description: ORIGINAL Step A impact-summary, preserved verbatim.

description.description: ORIGINAL Step A description, preserved verbatim — do not rewrite it. This is the historical record of what the finder proposed.

severity.description: The finder's ORIGINAL Step A severity, preserved as-found (not revised) — part of the historical record.

confidence.description: The finder's ORIGINAL Step A confidence, preserved as-found.

category.description: Optional. ORIGINAL Step A category, preserved.

tags.description: Optional. ORIGINAL Step A tags, preserved.

dismissal-reason.description: Why this was judged not a real bug (unreachable, already guarded, misread the code, …).

dismissed-by.description: Which stage dismissed it: 'unit' = the per-unit Step D; 'aggregator' = the aggregation-level cross-unit re-verification run by the skill. Everything other than 'dismissal-reason' and 'dismissed-by' is the preserved original.
